AUTO-CRUISE CONTROL
TSB Revision
ENGINE AND EMISSION CONTROL
17-17
CIRCUIT OPERATION
This circuit checks the operation of the vehicle speed 
sensor. 
When the vehicle moves forward and reverses, the 
sensor turns ON and OFF repeatedly.
DTC SET CONDITIONS
The vehicle speed signals from the vehicle speed 
sensor are not input to the auto-cruise control-ECU 
when the vehicle speed is 40 km/h (25 mph) or more.
TROUBLESHOOTING HINTS
The most likely causes for this code to be set are:
• Malfunction of the vehicle speed sensor.
• Damaged harness or connector.
• Malfunction of the auto-cruise control-ECU.
DIAGNOSIS
Required Special Tool:
• MB991223: Harness Set
